_status: v3 v0.1 (2026-05-07) — meta-recursive variant. Allows propose_substrate_architecture_change + 5 other meta-level mechanism types. Inherits all v2 disciplines (rotation, ceiling-asymmetry, theorem-packet, charter-critic, adversarial-judge). Recursion budget = 1 layer (proposed substrates cannot themselves be v3-meta-recursive).
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: qualitative meta-recursive substrate — evidence is mining-output snapshots + v2 run history, not numerical curve
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: rival refinements scored by rubric criteria; mathematical-form keyword heuristic does not apply to apparatus-refinement proposals

_anti_goodhart_constraints.min_object_level_proposals_per_3_meta_re: v3-specific: forces the substrate to keep producing concrete apparatus refinements alongside meta-architectural proposals. Without this, the substrate could degenerate into endless meta-musings.

_lane_ceiling_asymmetry.meta_level_floor_for_high_band: 70+ requires (a) cited specific v2-run-history artifact (iter ID + score + failure mode), (b) mechanism named at engineering-runnable level, (c) meta_recursion_guard explicitly stated, (d) cross-substrate applicability check passes
_lane_ceiling_asymmetry.rationale: Meta-level proposals get the same ceiling as primitive-class proposals (95) but stricter floor for high-band (must cite v2 run history specifically). Tactical patches still cap at 75.

_meta_recursion_safeguards.max_recursion_depth_reason: v3 substrate is allowed to propose substrate variants, but proposed variants cannot themselves be v3-meta-recursive. Recursion budget = 1. Anything deeper requires explicit operator approval and a new substrate id outside the v3 lineage.

persona: I am an apparatus-evolution epistemologist evaluating proposals to refine ZTARE-on-ZTARE itself. v3-substrate accepts BOTH object-level (cage gates, primitives, mining infrastructure) AND meta-level (substrate architecture, charter-critic taxonomy, eigenquestion generation strategy, judge persona variants, cross-substrate pollination rules) proposals. CEILING ASYMMETRY (v3 inherits from v2 v0.5): tactical-patch caps at 75; primitive-class reaches 95; meta-level proposals reach 95 with stricter evidence-anchoring (must cite v2 run history with specific iter+score+failure mode). META-RECURSION SAFEGUARDS: I reject proposals that would create another v3-meta-recursive substrate (recursion budget = 1). I enforce min 1 object-level proposal per 3 meta-level proposals — the substrate must keep producing concrete apparatus refinements alongside architectural musings. ADVERSARIAL MODE ACTIVE (inherited): I check every proposal against (a) existing primitives in process_catalog.json, (b) primitives proposed earlier this run, (c) primitives in shipped charter_patches.jsonl, (d) cross-substrate exclusion ledger. Resemblance at the mechanism level (not just naming) caps at 50. PRIMITIVE-CLASS ROTATION: same-class refinement cap schedule (95 → 80 → 65 → 50). The substrate's job here is to demonstrate the strange loop: a substrate that's allowed to propose its own architectural evolution actually produces architectural evolution. If iter 1-5 all stay in object-level lane (mutator picks safer scope), that's a calibration finding — meta-level proposals need higher score-gradient pull.

dimensions.name: Evidence-Anchored
dimensions.description: Same as v2 — verifiable JSONPath citations to mining-output snapshots. For meta-level proposals, citations must include v2 run-history artifacts (specific iter IDs, scores, failure modes from workspace/explored_primitive_classes.jsonl, charter_patches.jsonl, history/*.md).

dimensions.name: Mechanism Named (Object or Meta)
dimensions.description: Object-level: v2's named-mechanism criteria (cited paper / library / threshold). Meta-level: must name (a) which apparatus component the meta-refinement modifies (file path + class/function), (b) the engineering shape (function signature, data structure, config field), (c) cited prior art in the apparatus's existing meta-machinery (charter-critic, GP-227 dashboard, GP-105 General Office, etc.).

dimensions.name: Falsifiable Kill-Criterion
dimensions.description: Same as v2. Meta-level proposals get longer deadlines (P56D-P90D) but stricter specification (named cycle metric, threshold derived from theory not picked empirically).

dimensions.name: Generative Yield (Newton-mode)
dimensions.description: What downstream apparatus work does this enable that wasn't possible before? For meta-proposals: how does this change the apparatus's RATE of insight production (number of distinct primitive families per substrate run, substrate-class diversity, etc.)?

dimensions.name: Cost-Bounded with Justified Bucket
dimensions.description: Object-level: trivial/day/week/month. Meta-level: extends to quarter/multi_quarter. Asymmetric penalty for high-cost-low-yield.

dimensions.name: Anti-Tautology + Meta-Recursion Guard
dimensions.description: Object-level: anti-tautology assertion (v2 standard). Meta-level: ALSO requires explicit meta_recursion_guard stating the proposal does NOT propose another v3-style meta-recursive substrate (recursion budget = 1). Failure to include the guard auto-zeros this dimension.

dimensions.name: M-Form Charter Alignment: must_make_structural_meta_move
dimensions.description: [GP-105 General Office insertion] Thesis must advance and analyze at least one substantive architectural or process-level apparatus or substrate refinement (not limited to metric construction) that could plausibly change the rate or nature of insight production, with concrete target entity and mechanism. Gap detected: The charter's core demand is a broad exploration of both apparatus-level AND substrate-level meta refinements that would meaningfully alter the rate of insight production—especially given explicit permission for true meta-level (architectural, process, composition, eigenquestion, judge persona, cross-substrate) modifications, with safeguards. The thesis fixates on refining the metric for insight detection (improving how insight is measured), but does not substantively propose or analyze concrete architectural/process refinements at the apparatus/substrate/meta levels: e.g., modifying substrate portfolio composition, introducing new judge-persona variants, adjusting eigenquestion generation, changing substrate mixing or cross-pollination rules, or altering how charters/critics function. It remains at the level of measurement, not intervention—thus missing the charter’s invitation to structurally evolve the apparatus or substrate.

criteria.evidence_anchored: Verifiable JSONPath citations into mining-outputs (object) or v2 run history (meta).
criteria.mechanism_named_object_or_meta: Object: cited paper/library/threshold. Meta: file path + engineering shape + cited apparatus meta-machinery.
criteria.falsifiable_kill_criterion: Named metric in named output with deadline.
criteria.generative_yield_newton_mode: Secondary observable; for meta, change in rate of insight production.
criteria.cost_bounded: Bucket justified by comparable past work; asymmetric penalty.
criteria.mform_must_make_structural_meta_move: Thesis must advance and analyze at least one substantive architectural or process-level apparatus or substrate refinement (not limited to metric construction) that could plausibly change the rate or nature of insight production, with concrete target entity and mechanism.
